title: Schema of separation
summary: A definable condition can select a subset of an already existing set.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared first-order set theory context is fixed.

content.plain: A definable condition can select a subset of an already existing set.
content.exact: For each formula φ(x,p̄), ∀A∃B∀x[x∈B↔(x∈A∧φ(x,p̄))], subject to the schema's variable conditions.
content.example: The even members of a given finite set form a set.
content.caveat: Separation is an axiom schema, not unrestricted comprehension; it does not create a set of all objects satisfying φ.
